title: 第292章 问道第291章 问道宫
slug: 别人修仙我闲逛游历三界终长生
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：别人修仙我闲逛，游历三界终长生第一卷：默认第292章问道（..la）纪风抬眼看去，问道宫并不以恢弘壮丽取胜。
整座道宫依崖而建，背靠崆峒山，面朝泾水。
青砖垒砌宫墙，黛瓦铺覆屋顶，梁柱都是山中古木。
没有浓墨重彩的雕梁画栋，没有金碧辉煌的琉璃飞檐，只有一派洗尽铅华的古朴清寂。
踏入问道宫内，映入眼帘的是一方庭院。
忽然，知白拉了拉纪风仙袍的衣角，手指向庭院中央：
“公子公子，你们看！”
“那里有一只大乌龟托着一块石碑！”
纪风望去，庭院正中央，一尊庞大的石雕伏地昂首，背上驮着一块巨大的青石碑。
青石碑历经千万年的风雨侵蚀，边角有些磨损，但上边的字迹依旧清晰可见。
绾绾笑道：
“知白，什么大乌龟，这可不是寻常石龟。”
知白眨了眨眼睛，好奇的问道：
“绾绾，不是乌龟？”
“那它是啥啊？”
“它叫赑屃。”
“赑屃？”
“嗯嗯。”
绾绾点了点头，说道：
“赑屃是龙之九子之一，形似龟，力大无穷，能负万钧重物。”

“它生性好文，又喜负重，所以历代的石碑、经幢，多由它来驮负。”
“此地为万古问道之源，九州求道圣地，承载了黄帝问道的功德、广成祖师传道的恩泽。”
“所以立碑铭刻，自然要请赑屃来负，才算郑重。”
“又象征大道亘古不变，道统稳稳传承，求真之心亘古不移，千秋不灭。”
“原来如此。”
众人闻言纷纷恍然，看向石雕赑屃与古碑的目光多了几分郑重。
众人走近石碑，上边写到：
“黄帝立为天子十九年，令行天下，闻广成子在于崆峒之上，故往见之......
黄帝曰：‘闻吾子达于至道，敢问：治身奈何而可以长久？’
广成子蹶然而起，曰：‘善哉问乎！来，吾语汝至道：至道之精，窈窈冥冥……故我修身千二百岁矣，吾形未常衰。’
黄帝再拜稽首曰：‘广成子之谓天矣！’
广成子曰......”
碑文完整记载了黄帝问道广成祖师的内容。
随后几人绕过古碑，踏入主殿。
殿中有两尊石刻坐像。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Others are cultivating immortals while I am wandering around, traveling in the three realms to live forever. Volume 1: Default Chapter 292 Asking (..la) Ji Feng raised his eyes and saw that the Palace of Asking did not win with grandeur.
The entire Taoist palace is built on a cliff, backed by Kongtong Mountain and facing the Jingshui River.
The palace walls are built with green bricks, the roof is covered with black tiles, and the beams and columns are all ancient trees from the mountains.
There are no richly decorated carved beams and painted pillars, no magnificent glazed eaves, only a simple and quiet style that has washed away all the beauty.
Stepping into the Taoist Palace, you will see a courtyard.
Suddenly, Zhibai pulled the corner of Jifeng's fairy robe and pointed to the center of the courtyard:
"My lord, my lord, look!"
"There's a big turtle holding a stone tablet there!"
Ji Feng looked around and saw a huge stone sculpture lying on the ground with its head raised in the center of the courtyard, carrying a huge bluestone tablet on its back.
The bluestone tablet has been eroded by millions of years of wind and rain, and the corners are somewhat worn, but the writing on it is still clearly visible.
Wanwan smiled and said:
"Zhibai, what a big turtle, this is no ordinary stone turtle."
Zhibai blinked and asked curiously:
"Wanwan, not a turtle?"
"Then what is it?"
"It's called Bixi."
"Bi Xi?"
"Yeah."
Wanwan nodded and said:
"Bixi is one of the nine sons of the dragon. He looks like a turtle and is extremely powerful. He can carry tens of thousands of heavy objects."
"It is good at writing and likes to carry heavy loads, so it has been used to carry many stone tablets and scripture pillars in the past dynasties."
"This place is the source of eternal Taoism and the holy land of Jiuzhou Taoism. It carries the merits of Huangdi Taoism and the grace of Patriarch Guangcheng."
"So when erecting a monument and engraving it, it is natural to ask Bixi to bear it. This is considered solemn."
"It also symbolizes the eternal Tao, the steady inheritance of Taoism, the everlasting pursuit of truth, and the everlasting spirit."
"That's it."
Everyone was suddenly enlightened after hearing this, and looked at the stone carvings and ancient monuments with a bit more solemnity.
Everyone approached the stone tablet, which read:
"In the 19th year of the Yellow Emperor's establishment as emperor, he traveled around the world. He heard that Guangchengzi was on Kongtong, so he went to see him...
Huangdi said: "Having heard that my son has reached the Supreme Path, I dare to ask: What can be done to cure the body so that it can last long?" ’
Guangchengzi jumped up and said, "What a good question!" Come, I will speak to you of the Perfect Way: The essence of the Perfect Way is graceful and graceful... Therefore, I have been cultivating my body for a thousand and two hundred years, and my form has not always declined. ’
Huangdi paid homage to Jishou again and said, "Guangchengzi is called Heaven!" ’
Guangchengzi said..."
The inscription completely records the content of Huangdi's question to Patriarch Guangcheng.
Then several people walked around the ancient monument and entered the main hall.
There are two seated stone statues in the hall.
